# Airbnb

4 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit), 1 advanced (5), 1 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/airbnb/listing - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Airbnb listing in full: title, property type (place.category), description, area, coordinates, rating out of 5 and review count, photos, amenities, and the check-in and check-out times. With check_in and check_out it also prices that stay in place.hotel.prices. A listing id that does not exist answers 503 with a note to check the id, not 404, because Airbnb answers the same way for both; it is never charged.

**Use when** you want to inspect one property, and add check_in and check_out to price that stay. A listing id that does not exist is never charged.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Airbnb listing id, for example 33579922. Send id or url. · e.g. `33579922`
- `url` (optional, string) - An Airbnb listing link, for example https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/33579922.
- `check_in` (optional, string) - Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with check_out.
- `check_out` (optional, string) - Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with check_in.
- `adults` (optional, integer, 1-16) - Adults for the priced stay, 1 to 16.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. |

+16 more (types in the full schema): `place` {image_urls, latitude, longitude, reviews_count}; `place.hotel` {amenities, check_in_time, check_out_time, prices}; `place.rating` {max, value}; `place.ext` {capacity, category_ratings, exact_location, host_profile, listing_price_note, room_type}. Never filled: `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/airbnb/listing" \
  --data-urlencode "id=33579922" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/airbnb/listing/availability - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns an Airbnb listing's calendar night by night for up to 12 months: whether each night is available and bookable, whether a stay can start or end on it, and the minimum and maximum stay. A closed night that still allows check-out is the last night of someone's booking. Nights beyond the host's own booking window come back unavailable, so a long closed run at the end usually marks the window's edge, not bookings. There is no per-night price here; GET /v1/airbnb/listing with dates prices a stay.

**Use when** you want to check open dates or gauge how booked a property is. It has no nightly price, so chain listing with dates to price a stay.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - Up to 12 months of nights come back in one call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026: 365 nights in one page).

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Airbnb listing id, for example 33579922. Send id or url. · e.g. `33579922`
- `url` (optional, string) - An Airbnb listing link, for example https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/33579922.
- `from` (optional, string) - Any date inside the first month to return, YYYY-MM-DD. Default this month.
- `months` (optional, integer, 1-12) - Months to return, 1 to 12. Default 12.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {listing_id string, start_date string, end_date string, nights_available number}; `nights[]` {date string, available boolean, bookable null, available_for_checkin boolean, available_for_checkout boolean, min_nights number, max_nights number}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/airbnb/listing/availability" \
  --data-urlencode "id=33579922" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/airbnb/listing/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns an Airbnb listing's guest reviews, up to 24 a page, each with its rating out of 5, the text in the language the guest wrote it (review.language; review.translated says whether Airbnb also published a translation), date, the guest's first name and location, and the host's reply in review.responses. data.total is the listing's full review count, so a sample is never mistaken for the whole set. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to read what guests liked or complained about. The total review count comes back too, so a sample is not mistaken for the whole set.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free. With `max_pages`, `max_items` or `max_credits`, each page walked is billed at this price (a cached page is free), and `max_credits` caps the total.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · default page size not measured; set with `limit` · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Airbnb listing id, for example 33579922. Send id or url. · e.g. `33579922`
- `url` (optional, string) - An Airbnb listing link, for example https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/33579922.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-24) - Reviews to return, 1 to 24. Default 24.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` (1) · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality); `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.
- `reports`, `label_evidence` are no-ops without `label` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `goal`, `fit_tokens` are no-ops without `fit` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `label`: at most 5 comma-separated values.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `review.author.name` | Reviewer name. |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.entity_id` | ID of the reviewed entity… |

+12 more (types in the full schema): `review` {language, responses, translated}; `computed.labels` {incentivized, injection, issue, reports, sentiment}; `review.author` {avatar_url, location}; `review.rating` {max, value}. Never filled: `review.author.reviews_count`, `review.author.url`, `review.helpful_votes`, `review.images`, `review.original_language`, `review.source`, `review.title`, `review.url`, `review.verified`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`, `data.review_topics`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/airbnb/listing/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "id=33579922" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/airbnb/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns up to 18 Airbnb listings a page for a place, each with its name, coordinates, rating out of 5, review count, photos and priced stay in place.hotel.prices (the total, the per-night price, the total before any discount, and taxes and fees). Without check_in and check_out the search prices Airbnb's own default stay, echoed back in data.check_in and data.check_out. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to compare stays in an area. Add check_in and check_out to price your dates, or you get Airbnb's default stay.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · ≈18/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/18) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `location` (required) - A place, for example Lisbon, Portugal. · e.g. `Lisbon, Portugal`
- `check_in` (optional, string) - Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with check_out.
- `check_out` (optional, string) - Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with check_in.
- `adults` (optional, integer, 0-16) - Adults, 0 to 16.
- `children` (optional, integer, 0-15) - Children, 0 to 15.
- `infants` (optional, integer, 0-5) - Infants, 0 to 5.
- `pets` (optional, integer, 0-5) - Pets, 0 to 5.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.image_urls` | Image URL, or a list of image URLs, for the place. |
| `place.latitude` | Latitude in decimal degrees. |
| `place.longitude` | Longitude in decimal degrees. |

+7 more (types in the full schema): `place` {reviews_count}; `place.hotel` {prices}; `place.rating` {max, value}; `place.ext` {listing_badges, listing_price_note, subtitle}. Never filled: `place.address`, `place.category`, `place.description`, `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.verified`. Page-level: `data.check_in`, `data.check_out`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/airbnb/search" \
  --data-urlencode "location=Lisbon, Portugal" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
